highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers a wave of managed-code performance wins and expands WASM support to .NET 11.
highlights_body: This release focuses on eliminating unnecessary allocations and P/Invoke round-trips across color conversion, text shaping, and tag parsing. WASM gets Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11. Multiple upstream Skia m151 stability syncs and a CPU raster regression fix land too.

bullets.lead: Skia milestone m151 and upstream stability fixes
bullets.detail: The baseline was updated to Skia m151, and four subsequent upstream cherry-pick syncs from the Skia chrome/m151 branch were applied. A CPU raster regression introduced by a shader-context change was also reverted.

bullets.lead: ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor hex parsing
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse, TryParse, and related methods now accept ReadOnlySpan<char> alongside string, enabling zero-allocation hex color parsing in hot paths.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was not released when FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) failed or was given an out-of-bounds rectangle, leading to a silent native memory leak.

bullets.lead: Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions
bullets.detail: GRContextOptions no longer carries an unsafe modifier that served no purpose, improving analyzer clean-ness for consumers referencing the type.

SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKFourByteTag parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, SKShaper glyph reading, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms setup are all ported to managed math or zero-copy spans, eliminating per-call allocations and P/Invoke overhead.

Pre-built Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are now available for .NET 11 WASM targets. The new emsdk uses the exnref exception-handling model, and a preview WASM test leg validates exception-handling regressions.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzz 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free AddUtf8(string) via pooled char arrays and removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse, making text shaping pipelines significantly cheaper.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Contributed Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11 and fixed a long-standing WASM build definition issue.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 established the 4.151.0 baseline by updating Skia to milestone m151 and landing the first round of upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the bulk of the performance work: managed-code color conversion, zero-copy glyph result spans, allocation-free HarfBuzz tag parsing, and the SKColor ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, plus additional upstream m151 fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, the exnref exception-handling build, the CPU raster regression revert, the SKImage resource leak fix, and the final round of upstream m151 syncs.
